error_reason: The Planner agent repeatedly analyzed the exact same search results provided by WebSurfer across turns 1 through 14. Instead of identifying that the search query was yielding no useful information (only browser UI elements) and changing the strategy, the Planner continuously repeated the same 'Analysis of Previous Result' and 'Updated Understanding' conclusions regarding the ambiguity of the name and the chronological inconsistency, without ever instructing WebSurfer to perform a new, effective search or stop the loop.

suggested_fix.fix_text: If the Planner agent detects that the WebSurfer has performed the same search query twice consecutively without yielding new information, it must immediately stop the loop and generate a final response summarizing the findings (or lack thereof), rather than repeating the analysis.

probe_details.notes: The error turns (1-14) accurately reflect a severe case of 'step_repetition'. The WebSurfer performed identical searches (starting from Turn 8/10/12/14 with the query 'Patrick Crichton-Stuart 1794 1859 father death') multiple times. The Planner failed to detect this stagnation, repeatedly generating near-identical 'Analysis of Previous Result' and 'Updated Understanding' blocks regarding the same chronological inconsistency. This indicates a complete failure in loop termination logic.
